report_name: Workington Local Cycling and Walking Infrastructure Plan (LCWIP) 2022 - 2037
how_pct_was_used: The Propensity to Cycle Tool (PCT) was used as a data source to identify the most popular cycle routes for school and travel to work journeys.
other_tools_developed: A prioritisation framework that assesses effectiveness, alignment with policy objectives, economic factors, and deliverability.
specific_evidence_of_impact: The Workington Town Deal secured £23m from the Government’s Town Fund in 2021, which includes proposals for high-quality public realm, urban connectivity, and green infrastructure improvements such as upgrades to the Hadrian’s Cycleway (NCN72) on Central Way.
